contract.anchor: ## 19. PHASE-MANTA-B2B administrative client-preview route position — R3

active_phase.immediate_objective: PHASE-MANTA-B2B-ADMIN-CLIENT-PREVIEW-ROUTE-POSITION-CORRECTION-R3 closed the LAST open acceptance defect of the already-published PHASE-MANTA-B2B, with ZERO migrations and db/** byte-unchanged; the phase now awaits architect technical AND visual ACCEPTANCE and is NOT accepted and NOT self-accepted. DEFECT: the administrative block labelled O QUE O CLIENTE VE (buildClienteEvolution in js/screens/pedido-detail-render.js) read BOTH its position and its denominator from getClienteTrackingProgress, which is defined over the full canonical eight-step list, and never consulted the route - so a Manta-only Pedido at Tecelagem displayed Etapa 4 de 8 while the actual client presentation for that same Pedido publishes SEVEN visible steps, leaving the omitted Acabamento inside the visible denominator and making the block fail its own label; the progress bar inherited the same wrong total. ROOT CAUSE: R2 made the CLIENT surface route-aware but left this ADMINISTRATIVE PREVIEW reading the canonical Pedido-level totals directly. CORRECTION: js/pedido-tracking-ui.js - the owner of the client tracking vocabulary - gained ONE pure function, getClienteTrackingPreviewPosition(routes, canonicalIndex), which TRANSLATES the Pedido-level canonical position into the applicable VISIBLE route shape by composing the helpers that already existed (getClienteTrackingSectionsForRoutes, getClienteTrackingRoutePosition, getClienteTrackingStepIndex); with exactly one applicable route it returns the route-local ordinal, so Manta reads Etapa 4 de 7 while Tapete keeps Etapa 4 de 8 verbatim, and with zero or two applicable routes it refuses to fabricate a single route-local ordinal that would be false for both routes and instead declares the reading to be Pedido-level (Etapa comercial 4 de 8) plus a per-route local reached/next summary from the same existing helpers (Rota Tapete: Tecelagem . proxima Acabamento | Rota Manta: Tecelagem . proxima Expedicao). buildClienteEvolution consumes that result for the label, the denominator AND the percentage and reproduces no route-shape array of its own; the route arrives as view.pedidoRoutes, already derived from modelos.tipo_produto, and is never inferred from ops.tipo, names, width or suppliers. The position span carries data-rv-preview-position=route-local|pedido-level and the mixed note carries data-rv-preview-route-note, so both are directly assertable. NOT CHANGED: no migration, no db/** delta, no SQL, no RPC, no ACL/RLS/Auth change; status_cliente_visual remains the single Pedido-level authority and is neither written nor reinterpreted; NO per-route position is persisted, so the accepted limitation recorded in contract 18.2 stands unchanged; no new module and therefore no index.html change; D1-D4 behaviour unchanged; no administrative datum exposed to the client. The ACTUAL client route sections are untouched, proved at byte level - the R3 captures of the client Manta and client mixed surfaces have SHA-256 IDENTICAL to their R2 counterparts. EVIDENCE: tests/manta-route-ui.smoke.js extended with eight R3 proofs (48 to 56 green) covering the Manta denominator of seven and the 4 de 7 ordinal, the Tapete retention of eight, the mixed refusal of a single route-local total together with its per-route summary and the Manta next step being Expedicao and never Acabamento, the degradation to Pedido level without a reliable route, the whole Manta route walked as a contiguous 1/7..7/7 (D2 preserved), the render consuming the helper while duplicating no step list, the absence of any db/** delta, and the structural gates; tests/pedido-detail.smoke.js failing-name set IDENTICAL to the 3ed9c4a baseline at 41, and the full node --test tests/**/*.js sweep IDENTICAL at 126 failing names - ZERO INTRODUCED FAILURES, proved by name-level diff after temporarily restoring the pristine 3ed9c4a content of the changed files by plain file copy (no stash, no reset, no restore) and then byte-verifying the restoration of the corrected files; no existing Tapete assertion was weakened. The 126 pre-existing failures include environment-dependent cases such as the local static server on port 8765 not running. STRUCTURE: pedido-detail-events.js held at exactly 2709 lines and pedido-detail-progress.js at exactly 918 - neither gated file enlarged - with no DML in any render module and no broad refactor. Visual validation used a DISPOSABLE local fixture loading the real product modules with no network, no Supabase project, no Vercel, no fabricated session and no real business data: ten captures (full pages plus close-ups of the corrected block at 1440px and 375px), zero console errors, 62 of 62 visual assertions green, document-level horizontal overflow zero on every full-page capture and nothing lost to a clipping container; the fixture and its browser profile were destroyed and no screenshot is committed.
